sources.description: Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal clean-shaven man, receding short black side-part hair/brows, thick black round-square glasses over eyes. Beige high pointed shirt buttoned to neck, reddish-brown suspenders with small metal adjusters. Serious closed mouth, blue backdrop. Keep hair/brows/glasses/suspenders/shirt/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal man, short dark curled side-part hair/brows, fine narrow moustache only/clean chin. Tan broad-lapel suit/white pointed shirt/brown patterned tie; viewer-left hand holds curved dark smoking pipe at mouth with wispy smoke. Serious expression, blue background. Preserve hair/moustache/pipe/hand/smoke/clothes/crop/light; short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal man, short black side-part hair/brows, thick black moustache only and clean chin, thin round metal glasses over eyes. White lab coat/white collar/dark teal ribbed sweater; clipped blue-bordered ID at viewer right and black/gold pen at viewer left. Serious mouth, blue background. Preserve accessories/hair/moustache/clothes/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck, unreadable ID text.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal man, swept-back white-grey hair/brows, grey moustache only/clean chin. Purple draped shawl over high cream pointed shirt with gold center buttons, dark narrow inner edge visible. Serious downturned mouth, blue background. Preserve hair/moustache/shawl/shirt/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal bald-crown man with white side hair/brows/grey moustache only, round dark glasses with hanging brown cord. White lab coat/cream pointed shirt/gold-brown patterned tie; cropped black/silver stethoscope chestpiece at viewer right. Serious mouth, blue backdrop. Keep bald crown/side hair/glasses/cord/moustache/outfit/crop/light; short broad mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Elderly near-frontal man, short combed grey hair/brows and grey moustache only, clean chin. Dark olive coat/rust-brown ribbed scarf/olive high buttoned shirt; source-cropped aged cream papers at viewer right. Serious mouth on blue background. Preserve hair/moustache/scarf/papers/clothes/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal woman, dark brown short side-part rolled bob/brows, serious closed downturned mouth. White high collar with large gold flower brooch, dark navy apron straps/bib; cropped gold brass microscope tube and adjustment wheel at viewer right. Blue painted background. Keep hair/brows/brooch/apron/microscope/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.

Standalone full painted rectangle. Near-frontal woman with short dark side-part waved hair/brows, fine oval spectacles over eyes with long metal chain down both sides. Off-white lab coat/red ribbed roll-neck sweater; clipped white blue-topped ID viewer right, text unreadable. Serious mouth, blue backdrop. Preserve hair/glasses/chain/clothes/ID/crop/light; short broad fitted mascot neck.
